segments.source: Kadzeni umhlaba usemusha, tintsaba letinkhulu timbonye umhlaba njengengubo, kanye netihlahla letindze letifinyelela esibhakabhakeni.
Kulomhlaba, bekunelichibi lelishonako lelimnyama, litfulile libuye libandza.
Lenye yato beyihlotjiswe ngemakhekhevu kantsi lelenye beyiseyincane futsi itilungele.
Tinyoka tabona lingetulu lemhlaba lelimibalabala, timo kanye netidalwa letinetinsiba.
Ngalesikhatsi emanti avaleka futsi, tinyoka atizange tikhohlwe ngebuhle letibubonile.
"Angeke sikhone kuhlala kulelichibi lelimnyama lelibandzako sikhatsi lesidze", bakhuluma bobabili.
"Tinyoni tasemoyeni angeke tisihleke ngekutsi siphansi", kusho umngani wakhe.
Tacala tahlanganyela totimbili tabhukusha taphumela ngetulu ekukhanyeni.
Ngalesikhatsi bafika lapho ekugcineni kwemanti, kwenteka intfo lengakavami.
Ngaphansi kwetinhloko tabo kwamila imikhono lenetandla neminwe.
Besebangasito tinyoka, kodvwa bese kuyindvodza nemfati.
"Njalo ekuseni sitawubona kuphuma kwelilanga sive kufutfumala emihlane yetfu."
"Bese siba bangani netinyoni kanye netilwane letitidalwa letesabekako."
Babese bahamba bobabili emhlabeni wabo lomusha.
